lines: Never ask a liar why they lied.
they would have to lie again.
one lie is never born alone
It always needs another to keep alive to protect the last
Until even they forget
And the lie becomes the only story they remember
Let people lose you
Let them misunderstand you
Let them create their own stories
Don't rush to fix them
what you never needed to explain
when the right time comes
A beautiful face will age
and a perfect body will change
will always be a beautiful soul
faces are just the cover
souls are the story
If someone values you
they make time for you
genuine love is easy to recognize
because it shows up in simple ways
it's a text to check in
a call back when they said they would
a plan that actually happens
even on busy days they still show up
because you matter to them
The saddest thing a child can believe is
I'm only loved when
So when they mess up they don't just feel guilty.
They feel the distance more than the lesson.
That's why repair matters.
A hug. A calm voice. A second chance.
They learn: I can make mistakes and still be worthy of love.
they say by the time your child turns
and by the time that number rises to around 90%
a reminder of just how quickly time passes
the truth is childhood is short
it's a reason to lean in
one day these early years will be gone
almost all your forever memories
the first child you have is the one who makes you a parent
you grow alongside them
they're the one who taught you
you got through the difficult days
all the times you had to figure things out together
because they made you a parent, who taught you how strong love can be
they're your best friend
and the one who changed you forever
